name: Servo PWM Test
instructions: This single test checks four PWM GPIO setups: GPIO12, GPIO18, GPIO13, and GPIO19. All wiring is automatic. The test will prompt for switch position changes before each PWM test and ask for manual observation after each servo movement.

name: UART Loopback Test
instructions: Connect GPIO14 TXD, physical pin 8, to GPIO15 RXD, physical pin 10, before running. Make sure UART is enabled and serial console is disabled.
switch_checklist: Set All Switches to the DOWN position
Then set Switches U0 & U1 to the UP position

name: SPI Test
instructions: This test checks both SPI setups. Test 1 uses GPIO7, GPIO8, GPIO9, GPIO10, GPIO11, GPIO5, GPIO6, and GPIO13. Test 2 uses GPIO16, GPIO17, GPIO18, GPIO19, GPIO20, GPIO21, GPIO12, GPIO22, GPIO23, and GPIO24. All wiring is handled by the switch system.
switch_checklist: Set All Switches to the DOWN position
Set All S[0-7] & P[0-9] Switches to the UP position

name: Wi-Fi Ping Test
instructions: Connect the Raspberry Pi to a Wi-Fi network before running. This test checks wlan0, accepts IPv4 or IPv6, and pings google.com through the Wi-Fi interface.

name: GPIO 26-Pin LED Test
instructions: Connect three 10-segment LED displays with current-limiting resistors. GPIO 2 through GPIO 11 go to Display 1, GPIO 12 through GPIO 21 go to Display 2, and GPIO 22 through GPIO 27 go to the first 6 segments of Display 3. GPIO2 and GPIO3 may stay on when idle because they are I2C pins with pull-ups.
observation_prompt: Did each LED segment light correctly, including the final all-LEDs-on check?
switch_checklist: Set ALL Switches to the DOWN position

name: Audio Playback Test
instructions: Insure the speaker is connected to the AUX port and turn the switch on the speaker to the ON position. Insure there is a green light on the speaker before starting test. This test generates a 5-second tone in software and requires manual listening confirmation.
observation_prompt: Did you hear the 5-second audio tone clearly?

name: I2C OLED Screen Test
instructions: Connect OLED VCC to Pi 3.3V (Pin 1), GND to Pi GND (Pin 6), SDA to GPIO2 (Pin 3), and SCL to GPIO3 (Pin 5). Ensure I2C is enabled in raspi-config.
observation_prompt: Did the screen successfully transition through a solid bright display block, two alternating checkerboard patterns, and then completely turn off without leaving broken pixels or lines?
switch_checklist: Set ALL Switches to the DOWN position
Set Switches I0 & I1 to the UP position

name: CSI Camera Port Test
instructions: Connect the CSI camera ribbon cable to the Raspberry Pi camera port before running this test. This test checks that the Pi can detect the CSI camera, capture a still image, and show it to the user for confirmation.
